⟦{書斎|しょさい}→書斎：03760_shosai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{書棚|しょだな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a large bookcase in the study.

notes:
{書棚|しょだな} means bookshelf or bookcase. It is a standard word that can refer to anything from a small shelf unit to a large freestanding bookcase.

FORMS:
⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ (writing, book) + ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧ (shelf). The reading is a rare case where ⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧ retains on'yomi in a native-style compound.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧: bookshelf (more common in everyday speech)
- {書架|しょか}: bookshelves (more formal, used in libraries)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {書棚|しょだな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧: to arrange books on the shelf
- {書棚|しょだな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いっぱい: the bookshelf is full

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{書斎|しょさい}→書斎：03760_shosai⟧: study room
- ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧: shelf (general)
- {本|ほん}: book
